name: Interlock/InTr Round-Trip Correlation
purpose: Carry one governed request/result round trip across an existing Interlock/InTr boundary while preserving exact request/response correlation, destination profile binding, exactly-once semantics, loop prevention, and explicit transport-versus-application outcome separation.
trigger: an allowed governed operation requires a result to cross back through the same or a paired Interlock/InTr boundary
reuse_instructions: Reuse the existing protocol and boundary receipts. A response packet must bind the originating request and may not recursively become a new request. Replays must preserve prior terminal evidence rather than reminting a competing successful history.
